client: codex exec, read-only sandbox, --ignore-user-config, hooks disabled, live web search
return_text:
**Prioritize catalyst extraction, transcription, and parsing difficult exhibits.** Their value can be measured directly; forecasting and agent assistance need stronger local validation.

Selections below are best-fit candidates as of **2026-09-24**, not established universal winners. **A** = academic; **S** = maker-reported. Undated sources were checked on that date. Proposed acceptance thresholds are engineering gates, not published results.

| Workload; reason to run locally | Repository/model; runner-up | Evidence and date | Mac throughput/latency | Frozen acceptance test | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Catalyst classification and event extraction:** offerings, acquisitions, trial results, guidance changes; batch volume and private annotations. | [GLiNER2](https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2), **gliner2.5-base-v1**, 2026-08-24. Runner-up: installed [Qwen3.8-27B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B) for harder relationships. | **S**, [GLiNER2.5 evaluation](https://fastino.ai/blog/gliner2-5-span-free-information-extraction), 2026-08-24: Few-NERD F1 55.14; 16-task average 54.87. Financial catalyst accuracy **unknown**. | M5 Pro **unknown**; CPU inference is supported. Do not transfer older GLiNER speed claims. | Freeze 1,000 manually adjudicated 2024–2025 SEC/news passages, including negatives. Compare keyword rules and frontier extraction. Require ≥95% catalyst recall, ≥90% precision, source-span accuracy, and lower cost/document. | **Trial first:** directly useful research annotations; modest general benchmark scores require abstention. |
| **OCR/layout/table extraction from scanned exhibits:** batch processing and offline access. Use existing HTML/XBRL parsing first. | [PaddleOCR](https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR), [VL-1.6, 0.9B](https://huggingface.co/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR-VL-1.6), 2026-05-28. Runner-up: [olmOCR-2-7B-1025](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr). | **A/S**, [PaddleOCR report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03264), 2026-06: OmniDocBench v1.6 **96.33**. Different benchmark versions are not interchangeable. | M5 Pro pages/minute **unknown**; complete pipeline compatibility also needs verification. | Freeze 200 exhibit pages with transcribed tables. Compare deterministic PDF extraction and cloud vision. Require table TEDS ≥0.95, numeric-cell exact match ≥99.5%, and lower corrected-page cost. | **Trial:** valuable exception path; never treat OCR numbers as verified financial facts. |
| **Earnings-call transcription and agent dictation:** recurring audio volume, privacy, offline operation. | [FluidAudio](https://github.com/FluidInference/FluidAudio) + **Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3 CoreML**. Runner-up: [mlx-whisper](https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-examples/tree/main/whisper) + Whisper large-v3-turbo. | **S**, [NVIDIA card](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3), checked 2026-09-24: Open ASR benchmark Earnings-22 WER **11.42%**. | **Measured elsewhere:** [FluidAudio FLEURS](https://github.com/FluidInference/FluidAudio/blob/main/Documentation/Benchmarks.md), checked 2026-09-24: **207× realtime**, English, M4 Pro. M5 and long-call performance **unknown**. | Freeze Earnings-22 test files plus 100 finance dictations. Compare Whisper; require no worse WER, ≥98% ticker/number accuracy on dictations, ≥20× realtime. | **Trial first:** strong throughput evidence; finance entities need separate scoring. |
| **Tabular catalyst/outcome experiments:** repeatable private research without sending feature tables to cloud LLMs. | [TabICLv2](https://github.com/soda-inria/tabicl), checkpoint **20260212**. Runner-up: [TabPFN-3.5](https://github.com/PriorLabs/TabPFN), checkpoint **20260909**, restricted weights. | **A**, [TabICLv2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11139), 2026-02; TabArena/TALENT. **A/S**, [TabPFN-3.5](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17895), 2026-09: TabArena/BeyondArena leadership claim. Equities edge **unknown**. | M5 Pro **unknown**. TabICL reports <10 seconds for 50K×100 on **H100**, not this Mac. | Freeze point-in-time 2015–2025 equities features; predict +200% within 20 sessions. Include delistings, temporal splits and 20-session embargo. Beat logistic regression/CatBoost on PR-AUC and Brier score. | **Trial:** research challenger; TabICL’s permissive license favors it for this use. |
| **Volume/volatility forecasting experiments:** local batch research, no cloud-token serialization of numeric arrays. | [Chronos-2](https://github.com/amazon-science/chronos-forecasting), **120M**, 2025-10-20. Runner-up: [TimesFM-3](https://github.com/google-research/timesfm), 2026-08-31, stronger reported results but restricted weights. | **A/S**, [Chronos-2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.15821), 2025-10: fev-bench/GIFT-Eval. **S**, [Google](https://www.research.google/blog/timesfm-3-a-zero-shot-foundation-model-for-multivariate-forecasting/), 2026-08-31: newer benchmark leadership. | M5 latency **unknown**; benchmark leadership supplies no hardware estimate. | Freeze the same market archive; rolling forecasts using only then-known covariates. Compare seasonal-naive volume and EWMA volatility. Require ≥5% lower pinball loss with calibrated intervals. | **Trial, lower priority:** forecasting scores do not establish tradable returns. |
| **Asynchronous failure-log triage:** private logs and fewer cloud input tokens. | [Qwen3.8](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3.8) **27B**, 2026-08-14, existing Ollama. Runner-up: installed Qwen3.5-9B. | **S**, [model card](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B): Terminal Bench 2.1 **73.0**; triage-specific evidence **unknown**. | **Packet measurement:** 26 output tok/s; 250–320 input tok/s. Long-log prefill can dominate. | Freeze 500 labeled build/test failures. Compare regex extraction and frontier processing of raw logs. Require ≥99% failure recall, ≥30% fewer cloud tokens, no reduction in repair success. | **Trial:** advisory summaries with raw evidence retained; avoid synchronous hooks initially. |
| **Editor next-edit suggestions:** offline coding and private source. | [Sweep v2-7B model/inference repository](https://huggingface.co/sweepai/sweep-next-edit-v2-7B). Runner-up: [Sweep 1.5B](https://huggingface.co/sweepai/sweep-next-edit-1.5B). | Quality superiority **unknown**. [oMLX community benchmark](https://omlx.ai/benchmarks/performance/bs4hq2u5), 2026-08-19, reports hardware throughput, not edit usefulness. | **Measured elsewhere:** M5 Pro 20-GPU-core, 48GB, 8-bit: **32.2 tok/s at 8K**. Ollama latency **unknown**. | Freeze 300 chronological edit traces. Compare language-server completion; require ≥20% accepted suggestions and p95 ≤500ms, including prefill. | **Trial only if editing frequently:** little benefit to unattended CLI agents. |

Freeze dataset hashes, labels, model revisions, quantization and runner settings before tuning. Measure cold/warm latency, peak memory, correction time and cloud costs avoided. No tests were run.

[TabPFN-3.5](https://huggingface.co/Prior-Labs/tabpfn_3_5) and [TimesFM-3](https://huggingface.co/google/timesfm-3.0-pytorch) have noncommercial weight licenses; open code does not remove those restrictions.

**Skip locally:** frontier replacement, autonomous strategy selection, authoritative model judging, and speculative synthetic-market simulation—task-specific benefit is unproven. Keep arithmetic, corporate-action adjustments, portfolio risk, broker reconciliation and order state deterministic. Local execution does not itself make model outputs deterministic.
